items.q: It might have been Lotte Lenya (PHONETIC).

ctx.x: know they were singing that song at that time, in that cabaret. Because you had seven bands.
It might have been Lotte Lenya (PHONETIC). Did you meet her during those years?

At that time, see, those girls were busy up there and I was in the band, I was busy, too. (Inaudible). And names, you know, you remember names. And so then I made this contract and I went back. And as I said, I joined --- and (sic) then I was with (inaudible) Gene Kennedy. And we started -- I was playing at the Million Dollar Ballroom, (Inaudible) Million Dollar ballroom alright.
